neighborhoods.title: Planning neighborhoods
neighborhoods.description: Keep only notices in these Planning neighborhoods (e.g. "Mission", "Castro Upper Market"). Empty = all.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Keep only notices inside [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]. Requires geocoding.

center.title: Center [lng, lat]
center.description: With radiusKm: keep only notices within that distance. Results are sorted nearest first.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Distance from center. Ignored without center.

noticeTypes.title: Notice type contains
noticeTypes.description: Keep only notice types containing any of these words (e.g. "Hearing", "Variance", "311"). Empty = all.

upcomingOnly.title: Upcoming hearings only
upcomingOnly.description: Drop notices whose hearing date (or expiration, if no hearing) has passed.

geocode.title: Geocode addresses
geocode.description: Add lat/lng from DataSF's Enterprise Addressing System (the city's address registry). Needed for bbox/center filters.
